description: Renders a boolean input. Controlled component requiring `onValueChange` to update the `value` prop, otherwise it will render the supplied value instead of user changes.

disabled.description: If true, user cannot toggle the switch.

ios_backgroundColor.description: iOS only. Custom color for the background, visible when value is false or switch is disabled.

onChange.description: Called when the user attempts to change the switch. Receives the change event as argument.

onValueChange.description: Called when the user attempts to change the switch. Receives the new boolean value as argument. Use this to control the component.

ref.description: Ref setter assigned to the element node when mounted.

thumbColor.description: Color of the foreground switch grip. On iOS, setting this removes the drop shadow.

trackColor.description: Custom colors for the switch track. Should be an object with `{ false: color, true: color }`.

value.description: Current value of the switch. If true, the switch is turned on.

notes: Controlled component: always use `onValueChange` to update `value`.
iOS-specific background color can be set via `ios_backgroundColor`.
Use `thumbColor` and `trackColor` to customize the switch appearance.
